reason: I've paid for slides before, so the only reason I'd say yes is that I pay nothing until three real meetings have happened and I can mark the bad ones free. I'll take the free 15-company list, and if the companies are ones I didn't already know, I'll start the pilot, but I won't expect to pay anything in the first month.
objection: EUR 350 a meeting adds up to EUR 3,500, which is close to what a junior SDR with Apollo costs me for a couple of months, and then the knowledge stays in my house. And 'a logistics client got 45 meetings' with no name and no reference I can call means nothing to me.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 companies is generic or full of firms we already know, or they won't give me a logistics client I can phone, I walk away.
